episode_summary: Chris Wolfe shares his journey from a failed house flipping business to becoming a top-producing real estate agent in a new market. He emphasizes the importance of consistent daily actions like cold calling and open houses, and discusses how he uses systems to stay on track. Chris provides actionable insights for agents looking to build or rebuild their business from scratch.
